name: 2nd Shift
source:
Getting laid off from your job sucks. Now the employment agency has you working as a custodian at a local school. This isn't where you thought your life was going, and your weird co-worker isn’t helping things. Also, there is something off about everything here, but you can’t quite put your finger on what. Fuck your life. Scrubbing toilets got a little more complicated. What is the point of doing anything if the boulder rolls back down as soon as you reach the top?
